'use strict';

/* ============================================================
   Fire Babys Style Studio + Store v2
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   FIXES vs v1:
   - Customize 3D preview now renders the WORKING DRAFT (v1 read the
     saved look, so the preview never changed when tapping options).
   - Preview render loop is cancelled on close; WebGL failure falls
     back to a 2D face render instead of a blank canvas.
   - Save applies immediately and re-dresses the player.

   ECONOMY v2 (three currencies):
   - COINS (🪙)  : earned by playing. 10/game, 5/KO, 2/extinguish.
   - GEMS  (💎)  : premium. 1 per game win, 1 per 5 KOs, or buy below.
   - REAL MONEY  : Stripe Payment Links open in a new tab (GEMS tab).
   One-time migration: old gem balance -> coins, starter 100c + 5g.
   ============================================================ */

/* ---------------- state ---------------- */
var DEF_LOOK = { c:0, e:'happy', h:'wild', a:'none' };
function loadJSON(k, fb){ try{ var v=localStorage.getItem(k); if(v) return JSON.parse(v); }catch(e){} return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(fb)); }
function loadInt(k, fb){ try{ var v=parseInt(localStorage.getItem(k),10); if(!isNaN(v)&&v>=0) return v; }catch(e){} return fb; }
var FBC = {
  look: loadJSON('fb_customization', DEF_LOOK),
  coins: loadInt('fb_coins', 0),
  gems: loadInt('fb_gems', 0),
  kos: loadInt('fb_kos_total', 0),
  inv: loadJSON('fb_inventory', null) || { armor:[], weapons:['stick'], emotes:['wave'],
                                          eqArmor:null, eqWeapon:'stick', favEmote:'wave' }
};
function saveState(){
  try{
    localStorage.setItem('fb_customization', JSON.stringify(FBC.look));
    localStorage.setItem('fb_coins', String(FBC.coins));
    localStorage.setItem('fb_gems', String(FBC.gems));
    localStorage.setItem('fb_kos_total', String(FBC.kos));
    localStorage.setItem('fb_inventory', JSON.stringify(FBC.inv));
    var pal = FB_COLORS[FBC.look.c]||FB_COLORS[0];
    localStorage.setItem('fb3d_color', pal.body);
  }catch(e){}
}
/* one-time economy migration: v1 gems become coins, everyone starts 100c/5g */
(function fbMigrateEconomy(){
  try{
    if(localStorage.getItem('fb_economy_v2')) return;
    var oldGems = loadInt('fb_gems', 0);
    FBC.coins = 100 + oldGems;
    FBC.gems = 5;
    FBC.kos = 0;
    localStorage.setItem('fb_economy_v2', '1');
    saveState();
  }catch(e){}

/* ---------------- hair styling (post-process on makeBaby licks) ---------------- */
function fbStyleHair(g, style){
  try{
    var u = g.userData, licks = u.licks, R = u.R || 1;
    if(!licks) return;
    for(var i=0;i<licks.length;i++){
      var L = licks[i], lu = L.userData;
      /* remember factory defaults once so 'wild' can truly reset */
      if(lu.dfp===undefined){ lu.dfp=L.position.clone(); lu.dfr=L.rotation.clone(); }
      if(lu.hsx===undefined){ lu.hsx=1; lu.hsy=1; lu.hsz=1; }
      L.visible = true;
      if(style==='spiky'){
        lu.hsx=0.7; lu.hsy=1.6; lu.hsz=0.7;
        L.position.set(lu.dfp.x, R*0.95, lu.dfp.z);
      } else if(style==='curly'){
        lu.hsx=1.15; lu.hsy=0.7; lu.hsz=1.15;
        var a=(i/licks.length)*Math.PI*2;
        L.position.set(Math.cos(a)*R*0.45, R*0.85, Math.sin(a)*R*0.45);
      } else if(style==='mohawk'){
        if(i<5){
          lu.hsx=0.8; lu.hsy=1.5; lu.hsz=0.8;
          L.position.set((i-2)*R*0.28, R*1.0, 0);
          L.rotation.set(0,0,0);
        } else { L.visible=false; }
      } else if(style==='flattop'){
        var a2=(i/licks.length)*Math.PI*2;
        lu.hsx=1.0; lu.hsy=0.55; lu.hsz=1.0;
        L.position.set(Math.cos(a2)*R*0.55, R*1.02, Math.sin(a2)*R*0.55);
      } else { /* wild: restore factory defaults */
        lu.hsx=1; lu.hsy=1; lu.hsz=1;
        L.position.copy(lu.dfp); L.rotation.copy(lu.dfr);
      }
    }
  }catch(e){}
}

function fbSizzleSound(){
  try{
    if(typeof fbMuted!=='undefined' && fbMuted) return;
    if(!AC) AC = new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
    var t = AC.currentTime, dur = 0.4;
    var len = Math.floor(AC.sampleRate * dur), buf = AC.createBuffer(1, len, AC.sampleRate), d = buf.getChannelData(0);
    for(var i=0;i<len;i++){ d[i] = (Math.random()*2-1) * Math.pow(1-i/len, 2.2); }
    var src = AC.createBufferSource(); src.buffer = buf;
    var f = AC.createBiquadFilter(); f.type = 'lowpass';
    f.frequency.setValueAtTime(3200, t); f.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(350, t+dur);
    var gn = AC.createGain(); gn.gain.setValueAtTime(0.22, t); gn.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t+dur);
    src.connect(f); f.connect(gn); gn.connect(AC.destination); src.start(t);
    var o = AC.createOscillator(); o.type = 'sawtooth';
    o.frequency.setValueAtTime(850, t); o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(110, t+0.5);
    var g2 = AC.createGain(); g2.gain.setValueAtTime(0.05, t); g2.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t+0.5);
    o.connect(g2); g2.connect(AC.destination); o.start(t); o.stop(t+0.55);
  }catch(e){}
}
function fbReigniteSound(){
  try{
    if(typeof fbMuted!=='undefined' && fbMuted) return;
    if(!AC) AC = new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
    var t = AC.currentTime;
    var o = AC.createOscillator(); o.type = 'triangle';
    o.frequency.setValueAtTime(180, t); o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(720, t+0.28);
    var g = AC.createGain(); g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.07, t); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t+0.3);
    o.connect(g); g.connect(AC.destination); o.start(t); o.stop(t+0.32);
  }catch(e){}
}

/* ---------------- emotes ---------------- */
var FB_EMOTE_DUR = {};
FB_EMOTES.forEach(function(e){ FB_EMOTE_DUR[e.id] = e.dur; });
function fbPlayEmote(id, g){
  if(!g || !g.userData) return;
  try{
    var u = g.userData;
    if(u.fbEmote) return; // one at a time
    if(u.fbKO) return;
    u.fbEmote = { id:id, t:0, dur:FB_EMOTE_DUR[id]||1.2, y0:g.position.y };
    beepOk();
  }catch(e){}
}
function fbEmoteFrame(g, dt){
  try{
    var u = g.userData, em = u.fbEmote;
    if(!em) return;
    em.t += dt;
    var k = Math.min(1, em.t/em.dur), done = em.t >= em.dur;
    if(em.id==='wave'){
      g.rotation.z = Math.sin(em.t*10)*0.25*(1-k);
      g.position.y = em.y0 + Math.abs(Math.sin(em.t*8))*0.12;
    } else if(em.id==='dance'){
      g.rotation.y += dt*7;
      g.position.y = em.y0 + Math.abs(Math.sin(em.t*10))*0.22;
    } else if(em.id==='spin'){
      g.rotation.y += dt*(Math.PI*2/em.dur);
    } else if(em.id==='clap'){
      g.rotation.z = Math.sin(em.t*16)*0.18*(1-k);
      g.position.y = em.y0 + Math.abs(Math.sin(em.t*16))*0.08;
    } else if(em.id==='flip'){
      g.rotation.x = (em.t/em.dur)*Math.PI*2;
    } else if(em.id==='backflip'){
      g.rotation.x = -(em.t/em.dur)*Math.PI*2;
      g.position.y = em.y0 + Math.sin(Math.min(1,em.t/em.dur)*Math.PI)*0.8;
    } else if(em.id==='fire_spin'){
      g.rotation.y += dt*12;
      var s = 1 + Math.sin(em.t*16)*0.1;
      g.scale.set(s, 2-s, s);
      u.flash = Math.max(u.flash||0, 0.45);
    } else if(em.id==='moonwalk'){
      g.rotation.x = -0.3;
      g.position.y = em.y0 + Math.abs(Math.sin(em.t*12))*0.07;
      g.rotation.z = Math.sin(em.t*6)*0.1;
    } else if(em.id==='levitate'){
      g.position.y = em.y0 + Math.sin(Math.min(1,em.t/em.dur)*Math.PI)*1.1;
      g.rotation.y += dt*4;
      u.flash = Math.max(u.flash||0, 0.4);
    } else if(em.id==='super_saiyan'){
      var s2 = 1 + Math.sin(em.t*20)*0.12;
      g.scale.set(s2, 2-s2, s2);
      g.rotation.y += dt*9;
      u.flash = Math.max(u.flash||0, 0.6);
    } else if(em.id==='taunt'){
      var s3 = 1 + Math.sin(em.t*14)*0.08*(1-k);
      g.scale.set(s3, 2-s3, s3);
      u.flash = Math.max(u.flash||0, 0.35);
    } else if(em.id==='victory'){
      g.rotation.y += dt*5;
      g.position.y = em.y0 + Math.sin(Math.min(1,em.t/0.5)*Math.PI)*0.9;
    }
    if(done){
      g.rotation.x = 0; g.rotation.z = 0; g.scale.set(1,1,1);
      if(typeof em.y0==='number') g.position.y = em.y0;
      u.fbEmote = null;
    }
  }catch(e){ try{ g.userData.fbEmote=null; }catch(e2){} }
}
function fbDoEmote(id){
  try{
    if(typeof player==='undefined' || !player || !player.group || player.dead) return;
    if(typeof mpKO!=='undefined' && mpKO) return;
    if(typeof mpAtkAnimT!=='undefined' && mpAtkAnimT>0) return;

var fbNetWired = false;
function fbWireNet(){
  if(fbNetWired) return;
  try{
    if(typeof net==='undefined' || !net || typeof net.on!=='function') return;
    fbNetWired = true;
    net.on('action', function(msg){

        try{

          if(rp && rp.group && !rp.ko) fbPlayEmote((msg.data&&msg.data.id)||'wave', rp.group);
        }catch(e){}

        /* I scored the KO -> coins, gem every 5 KOs */
        try{
          if(msg.data && msg.data.by && typeof net!=='undefined' && msg.data.by===net.playerId){
            FBC.kos++; saveState();
            fbAddCoins(5, '+5 🪙 KO!');
            if(FBC.kos % 5 === 0) fbAddGems(1, '+1 💎 KO streak!', true);
          }
        }catch(e){}
      }
    });
    net.on('end', function(){
      fbAddCoins(10, 'Game complete! +10 🪙');
      fbAddGems(1, null, true); /* 1 gem per game played */
    });
  }catch(e){}
}

  if(fbPrev && fbPrev.raf){ try{ cancelAnimationFrame(fbPrev.raf); }catch(e){} }
  fbPrev = null;
  try{
    var cv = $('custpreview');

    cam.position.set(0, 1.4, 5.4); cam.lookAt(0, 0.7, 0);

function fbIsOwned(tab, id){
  if(tab==='armor') return FBC.inv.armor.indexOf(id)>=0;
  if(tab==='weapons') return FBC.inv.weapons.indexOf(id)>=0;
  if(tab==='emotes') return FBC.inv.emotes.indexOf(id)>=0;
  return false;
}
function fbIsEquipped(tab, id){
  if(tab==='armor') return FBC.inv.eqArmor===id;
  if(tab==='weapons') return FBC.inv.eqWeapon===id;
  if(tab==='emotes') return FBC.inv.favEmote===id;

function fbPriceText(it){
  if(it.p===0) return 'FREE';
  return (it.cur==='gems' ? '💎 ' : '🪙 ') + it.p + (it.cur==='gems' ? ' GEMS' : ' COINS');
}
function fbCanAfford(it){
  if(it.p===0) return true;
  return (it.cur==='gems' ? FBC.gems : FBC.coins) >= it.p;
}
function fbRenderStore(){
  var grid = $('storegrid'); if(!grid) return;

  if(fbStoreTab==='gems'){ fbStoreTab='armor'; } /* GEMS tab hidden until real payments exist */
  fbStoreItems(fbStoreTab).forEach(function(it){

    var card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'sitem'+(owned?' owned':'')+(eq?' equipped':'')+(fbConfirmId===it.id?' confirm':'');

    } else {
      priceHtml = '<div class="pr'+(fbCanAfford(it)?'':' lock')+'">'+esc(fbPriceText(it))+'</div>';
      if(fbConfirmId===it.id)

function fbStoreTap(it){
  beepOk();

  if(fbIsOwned(tab, it.id)){
    if(tab==='armor') FBC.inv.eqArmor = (FBC.inv.eqArmor===it.id) ? null : it.id;
    else if(tab==='weapons') FBC.inv.eqWeapon = it.id;
    else if(tab==='emotes') FBC.inv.favEmote = it.id;
    saveState(); fbDressPlayer(); fbSendLook(); fbRenderStore();
    toastOk('✅ Equipped: '+it.n);
    return;
  }
  if(!fbCanAfford(it)){
    toastOk(it.cur==='gems' ? '💎 Not enough gems! Win games or grab a pack.'
                            : '🪙 Not enough coins! Play games to earn more.');
    return;
  }
  if(fbConfirmId===it.id){
    fbConfirmId = null;
    if(it.cur==='gems') FBC.gems -= it.p; else FBC.coins -= it.p;
    if(tab==='armor'){ FBC.inv.armor.push(it.id); FBC.inv.eqArmor = it.id; }
    else if(tab==='weapons'){ FBC.inv.weapons.push(it.id); FBC.inv.eqWeapon = it.id; }
    else if(tab==='emotes'){ FBC.inv.emotes.push(it.id); FBC.inv.favEmote = it.id; }
    saveState(); fbDressPlayer(); fbSendLook(); fbRenderStore();
    toastOk('🎉 You got: '+it.n+'!');
  } else {
    fbConfirmId = it.id;
    clearTimeout(fbConfirmTimer);
    fbConfirmTimer = setTimeout(function(){ fbConfirmId=null; fbRenderStore(); }, 3000);

  }
}

/* ================= PERFORMANCE: graphics quality (FBQ) =================
   FBQ.level: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low', persisted in fb_quality.
   Mobile auto-defaults to medium. Changing quality in Settings reloads
   the page (antialias can only be set at renderer creation). */
var FBQ=(function(){
  var q=''; try{ q=localStorage.getItem('fb_quality')||''; }catch(e){}
  var mob=/Android|iPhone|iPad|iPod|Mobile|webOS|BlackBerry/i.test(navigator.userAgent||'');
  if(q!=='high'&&q!=='medium'&&q!=='low') q=mob?'medium':'high';
  var dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1;
  return {
    level:q, isMobile:mob,
    antialias:(q==='high'),
    pixelRatio:(q==='high'?Math.min(dpr,2):q==='medium'?Math.min(dpr,1.5):1),
    shadows:(q!=='low'),
    shadowSoft:(q==='high'),
    shadowSize:(q==='high'?2048:1024),
    particleScale:(q==='high'?1:q==='medium'?0.6:0.35),
    emberCount:(q==='high'?260:q==='medium'?150:60),
    botHz:(q==='low'?10:20)
  };
})();

function shade(hex, f){ // darken/lighten #rrggbb by factor f
  var n=parseInt(hex.slice(1),16), r=(n>>16)&255, g=(n>>8)&255, b=n&255;
  r=Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(r*f))); g=Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(g*f))); b=Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(b*f)));

/* Face painter: expressive mouths, zero bird traits. */
function drawFace(ctx, S, kind){
  var cx=S/2, cy=S/2, u=S/100;
  ctx.lineCap='round';
  function eye(x, y, r, style){
    ctx.fillStyle='#1a0a05';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff2e1a';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r*0.45, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.85)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x-r*0.15, y-r*0.2, r*0.18, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    if(style==='brow'){
      ctx.strokeStyle='#1a0a05'; ctx.lineWidth=2.4*u;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x-1.6*r, y-1.7*r); ctx.lineTo(x+1.5*r, y-0.9*r); ctx.stroke();
    } else if(style==='heavy'){
      ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(26,10,5,.9)'; ctx.lineWidth=2.2*u;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x-1.5*r, y-1.1*r); ctx.lineTo(x+1.5*r, y-1.1*r); ctx.stroke();
    } else if(style==='sharp'){
      ctx.strokeStyle='#1a0a05'; ctx.lineWidth=2*u;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x-1.7*r, y-0.6*r); ctx.lineTo(x+1.7*r, y-0.6*r); ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
  function mouth(style){
    ctx.strokeStyle='#1a0a05'; ctx.lineWidth=2.6*u;
    ctx.beginPath();
    if(style==='smirk'){ ctx.arc(cx+4*u, cy+11*u, 9*u, 0.15*Math.PI, 0.8*Math.PI); }
    else if(style==='grin'){ ctx.arc(cx, cy+9*u, 10*u, 0.1*Math.PI, 0.9*Math.PI); }
    else if(style==='open'){ ctx.fillStyle='#5a1408'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy+12*u, 6*u, 7.5*u, 0, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#ff6a4a'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy+15*u, 3.4*u, 3.4*u, 0, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); return; }
    else if(style==='jag'){
      ctx.beginPath(); var x0=cx-10*u;
      ctx.moveTo(x0, cy+12*u);
      for(var i=0;i<5;i++){ ctx.lineTo(x0+(i*4+2)*u, cy+(i%2? 8:14)*u); }
      ctx.lineTo(x0+20*u, cy+12*u); }
    else { ctx.arc(cx, cy+10*u, 8*u, 0.2*Math.PI, 0.8*Math.PI); }
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  var er=7*u, ey=cy-6*u, ex=13*u;
  if(kind==='cocky'){ eye(cx-ex,ey,er,'brow'); eye(cx+ex,ey,er,'brow'); mouth('smirk'); }
  else if(kind==='calm'){ eye(cx-ex,ey,er,'heavy'); eye(cx+ex,ey,er,'heavy'); mouth('smile'); }
  else if(kind==='sharp'){ eye(cx-ex,ey,er,'sharp'); eye(cx+ex,ey,er,'sharp'); mouth('grin'); }
  else if(kind==='fierce'){ eye(cx-ex,ey,er,'brow'); eye(cx+ex,ey,er,'brow'); mouth('open'); }
  else if(kind==='eager'){ eye(cx-ex,ey,er*1.15); eye(cx+ex,ey,er*1.15); mouth('open'); }
  else if(kind==='villain'){ eye(cx-ex,ey,er,'brow'); eye(cx+ex,ey,er,'brow'); mouth('jag'); }
  else if(kind==='happy'){
    ctx.strokeStyle='#1a0a05'; ctx.lineWidth=2.6*u;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx-ex, ey+3*u, er*0.95, Math.PI*1.12, Math.PI*1.88); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx+ex, ey+3*u, er*0.95, Math.PI*1.12, Math.PI*1.88); ctx.stroke();
    mouth('grin');
  }
  else if(kind==='cool'){
    ctx.fillStyle='#16161f';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx-ex, ey, er*1.3, er, 0, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx+ex, ey, er*1.3, er, 0, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle='#16161f'; ctx.lineWidth=1.8*u;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx-ex+er*1.15, ey-er*0.2); ctx.lineTo(cx+ex-er*1.15, ey-er*0.2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.4)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx-ex-er*0.35, ey-er*0.35, er*0.42, er*0.2, -0.5, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx+ex-er*0.35, ey-er*0.35, er*0.42, er*0.2, -0.5, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    mouth('smirk');
  }
  else if(kind==='angry'){
    eye(cx-ex,ey,er,'brow'); eye(cx+ex,ey,er,'brow');
    ctx.strokeStyle='#1a0a05'; ctx.lineWidth=2.6*u;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy+19*u, 8*u, Math.PI*1.2, Math.PI*1.8); ctx.stroke();
  }
  else if(kind==='sleepy'){
    ctx.strokeStyle='#1a0a05'; ctx.lineWidth=2.2*u;
    ctx.fillStyle='#1a0a05';
    [-1,1].forEach(function(s){
      var exx=cx+s*ex;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(exx-er*1.2, ey+er*0.5); ctx.lineTo(exx+er*1.2, ey+er*0.5); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(exx, ey+er*0.65, er*0.32, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    });
    ctx.fillStyle='#5a1408';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy+12*u, 3.5*u, 4.5*u, 0, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }
  else if(kind==='star'){
    [-1,1].forEach(function(s){
      var exx=cx+s*ex;
      ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(exx, ey, er*1.05, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle='#ffd76a';
      ctx.beginPath();
      for(var i=0;i<10;i++){
        var rr=(i%2===0)?er*0.72:er*0.3, aa=-Math.PI/2+i*Math.PI/5;
        var px=exx+Math.cos(aa)*rr, py=ey+Math.sin(aa)*rr;
        if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(px,py); else ctx.lineTo(px,py);
      }
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    });
    mouth('open');
  }
  else { eye(cx-ex,ey,er); eye(cx+ex,ey,er); mouth('smile'); }
}

/* Body texture: bright core -> body color -> dark edge, with face. */
function bodyTexture(spec, faceKind){
  var S=256, c=cnv(S,S), x=c.getContext('2d');
  var g=x.createRadialGradient(S/2,S*0.38,S*0.06, S/2,S/2,S*0.52);
  g.addColorStop(0, spec.core); g.addColorStop(0.45, spec.body); g.addColorStop(1, shade(spec.dark,0.85));
  x.fillStyle=g; x.fillRect(0,0,S,S);
  x.globalAlpha=0.16;
  for(var i=0;i<26;i++){
    x.fillStyle = i%2 ? spec.core : spec.dark;
    x.beginPath();
    x.arc(Math.random()*S, Math.random()*S, 6+Math.random()*16, 0, Math.PI*2); x.fill();
  }
  x.globalAlpha=1;
  drawFace(x, S, faceKind);
  return tex(c);
}

/* ---------------- shared FX textures ---------------- */
function flameTexture(){

  g.addColorStop(0.75,'rgba(255,200,90,0.9)'); g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,246,200,0)');
  x.fillStyle=g;

  x.bezierCurveTo(S*0.95,S*0.35, S*0.8,S*0.7, S*0.5,S);

}
function glowTexture(){

var FLAME_TEX=null, GLOW_TEX=null;

/* ---------------- fire baby factory ---------------- */
function makeBaby(spec, faceKind, scale){
  scale = scale||1;
  var g = new THREE.Group();
  var R = 1.0*scale;

  var bodyMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: bodyTexture(spec, faceKind), roughness:0.28, metalness:0.0 });
  var body = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(R, 22, 16), bodyMat);
  body.rotation.y = -Math.PI/2;
  body.castShadow=true;
  g.add(body);

  var glow = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({
    map:GLOW_TEX, blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite:false, transparent:true, opacity:0.85 }));
  glow.scale.set(R*4.5, R*4.5, 1);
  g.add(glow);

  var licks=[];
  var lickGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(R*0.34, R*1.15, 7);
  var lm = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map:FLAME_TEX, transparent:true,
    blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite:false, side:THREE.DoubleSide, opacity:0.95 });
  for(var i=0;i<7;i++){
    var cone = new THREE.Mesh(lickGeo, lm);
    var a = (i/7)*Math.PI*2 + Math.random()*0.5;
    cone.position.set(Math.cos(a)*R*0.72, Math.sin(a)*R*0.72, R*0.35);
    cone.rotation.z = a - Math.PI/2;
    cone.rotation.x = (Math.random()-0.5)*0.6;
    cone.userData.phase = Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
    cone.userData.base = 0.85+Math.random()*0.3;
    g.add(cone); licks.push(cone);
  }

  var shC=cnv(64,64), shX=shC.getContext('2d');
  var sg=shX.createRadialGradient(32,32,2,32,32,30);
  sg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0.42)'); sg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  shX.fillStyle=sg; shX.fillRect(0,0,64,64);
  var blob = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(R*2.6,R*2.6),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map:tex(shC), transparent:true, depthWrite:false }));
  blob.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2; blob.position.y=-R*1.52;
  g.add(blob);

  var dark = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color:new THREE.Color(spec.dark) });
  if(spec.extra==='headband'){
    var band = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(R*1.0, R*0.10, 8, 24), dark);
    band.rotation.x = Math.PI/2 - 0.35; band.position.y = R*0.42;
    g.add(band);
    var knot = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(R*0.16,R*0.34,R*0.06), dark);
    knot.position.set(-R*0.95, R*0.5, -R*0.25); knot.rotation.z=0.5;
    g.add(knot);
  } else if(spec.extra==='crown'){
    var gold = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color:0xffd76a, emissive:0x664400 });
    var circ = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(R*0.52,R*0.58,R*0.30,10), gold);
    circ.position.y = R*1.02; g.add(circ);
    for(var s=0;s<5;s++){
      var spike = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(R*0.11,R*0.34,6), gold);
      var sa=(s/5)*Math.PI*2;
      spike.position.set(Math.cos(sa)*R*0.48, R*1.28, Math.sin(sa)*R*0.48);
      g.add(spike);
    }
  } else if(spec.extra==='buns'){
    var bunMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map:bodyTexture(
      {body:spec.body, dark:spec.dark, core:spec.core}, 'none') });
    [-1,1].forEach(function(sgn){
      var bun = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(R*0.34,12,10), bunMat);
      bun.position.set(sgn*R*0.62, R*0.88, 0);
      g.add(bun);
    });
  } else if(spec.extra==='bow'){
    var wood = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color:0x8a5a2e });
    var arc = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(R*0.85, R*0.07, 8, 20, Math.PI*1.2), wood);
    arc.position.set(R*1.25, R*0.1, 0); arc.rotation.z = -Math.PI*0.1; arc.rotation.y = 0.5;
    g.add(arc);
    var strMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color:0xfff2cc });
    var p1 = new THREE.Vector3(R*1.25 + Math.cos(-Math.PI*0.1+Math.PI*0.6)*R*0.85, R*0.1 + Math.sin(-Math.PI*0.1+Math.PI*0.6)*R*0.85, 0);
    var p2 = new THREE.Vector3(R*1.25 + Math.cos(-Math.PI*0.1-Math.PI*0.6)*R*0.85, R*0.1 + Math.sin(-Math.PI*0.1-Math.PI*0.6)*R*0.85, 0);
    g.add(new THREE.Line(new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([p1,p2]), strMat));
  }

  g.userData = { licks:licks, R:R, body:body, glow:glow, blob:blob,
    bobPhase:Math.random()*Math.PI*2, flash:0, baseY:0 };
  addLimbs(g, R, spec.body, spec.dark);
  return g;
}
function updateBaby(g, t, dt){
  var u=g.userData;
  g.position.y = u.baseY + Math.sin(t*2.2+u.bobPhase)*0.16;
  g.rotation.y += dt*0.0; // facing handled by callers
  for(var i=0;i<u.licks.length;i++){
    var L=u.licks[i], s=L.userData.base*(0.85+0.3*Math.sin(t*9+L.userData.phase));
    var hx=L.userData.hsx||1, hy=L.userData.hsy||1, hz=L.userData.hsz||1;
    L.scale.set(s*hx, s*(1+0.25*Math.sin(t*11+L.userData.phase*2))*hy, s*hz);
  }
  u.glow.material.opacity = 0.78+0.2*Math.sin(t*7+u.bobPhase);
  if(u.flash>0){ u.flash-=dt*4; u.body.material.emissive.setRGB(Math.max(0,u.flash)*0.9, Math.max(0,u.flash)*0.35, Math.max(0,u.flash)*0.1); }
  // limb walk-swing from real displacement (chunky toy waddle)
  var lpx=(u.lastPX===undefined)?g.position.x:u.lastPX, lpz=(u.lastPZ===undefined)?g.position.z:u.lastPZ;
  var mdx=g.position.x-lpx, mdz=g.position.z-lpz;
  var moved=Math.sqrt(mdx*mdx+mdz*mdz);
  u.walkPhase=(u.walkPhase||0)+moved*2.6;
  u.lastPX=g.position.x; u.lastPZ=g.position.z;
  var swT=moved>0.0008?1:0;
  u.swingAmp=(u.swingAmp||0)+(swT-(u.swingAmp||0))*Math.min(1,dt*7);
  var sw=Math.sin(u.walkPhase)*0.6*(u.swingAmp||0);
  if(u.armL){ u.armL.rotation.x=sw; u.armR.rotation.x=-sw; u.legL.rotation.x=-sw; u.legR.rotation.x=sw; }
}

/* ---------------- arms & legs: chunky toy-like limbs, walk-swung ---------------- */
var LIMB_GEO_CACHE={}, LIMB_MAT_CACHE={};
function limbGeo(kind, R, len){
  var key=kind+'_'+R.toFixed(2);
  if(!LIMB_GEO_CACHE[key]){
    var rad=(kind==='arm'?0.18:0.22)*R;
    var g=new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(rad, len, 4, 10);
    g.translate(0, -len/2, 0); // pivot at the joint
    LIMB_GEO_CACHE[key]=g;
  }
  return LIMB_GEO_CACHE[key];
}
function limbMat(color){
  if(!LIMB_MAT_CACHE[color]) LIMB_MAT_CACHE[color]=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:new THREE.Color(color), roughness:0.4, metalness:0.0});
  return LIMB_MAT_CACHE[color];
}
function addLimbs(g, R, bodyColor, darkColor){
  var armLen=R*0.70, legLen=R*0.73;
  var armL=new THREE.Mesh(limbGeo('arm',R,armLen), limbMat(bodyColor));
  armL.position.set(-R*1.02, R*0.25, 0); armL.rotation.z=-0.12; armL.castShadow=true; g.add(armL);
  var armR=new THREE.Mesh(limbGeo('arm',R,armLen), limbMat(bodyColor));
  armR.position.set(R*1.02, R*0.25, 0); armR.rotation.z=0.12; armR.castShadow=true; g.add(armR);
  var legL=new THREE.Mesh(limbGeo('leg',R,legLen), limbMat(darkColor));
  legL.position.set(-R*0.38, -R*0.60, 0); legL.castShadow=true; g.add(legL);
  var legR=new THREE.Mesh(limbGeo('leg',R,legLen), limbMat(darkColor));
  legR.position.set(R*0.38, -R*0.60, 0); legR.castShadow=true; g.add(legR);
  g.userData.armL=armL; g.userData.armR=armR; g.userData.legL=legL; g.userData.legR=legR;
}

function updateEmbers(dt){

  hg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,170,80,0)');
  hg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,170,80,0.35)');

  x.fillStyle=sg2; x.fillRect(64,Math.round(S*0.62)-120,240,240);

}
function worldGroundTexture(){
  var W=512, H=1024, c=cnv(W,H), x=c.getContext('2d');
  function zToY(z){ return (52-z)/170*H; }
  BIOMES.forEach(function(b){
    var y0=zToY(b.z0), y1=zToY(b.z1);
    x.fillStyle=b.base; x.fillRect(0,y0,W,y1-y0);
  });
  // speckle + scorch everywhere (denser + warm flecks for a richer ground read)
  for(var i=0;i<7000;i++){
    var v=Math.random();
    x.fillStyle = v<0.45 ? 'rgba(28,20,16,0.22)' : (v<0.72 ? 'rgba(130,110,90,0.16)' : (v<0.88 ? 'rgba(16,12,10,0.3)' : 'rgba(255,190,120,0.10)'));
    var s=1+Math.random()*4;
    x.fillRect(Math.random()*W, Math.random()*H, s, s);
  }
  // soft warm light pools in the ember village band (torchlight feel)
  var py0=zToY(52), py1=zToY(18);
  for(var p9=0;p9<10;p9++){
    var px2=Math.random()*W, py2=py0+Math.random()*(py1-py0), pr2=26+Math.random()*44;
    var pg2=x.createRadialGradient(px2,py2,2,px2,py2,pr2);
    pg2.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,170,80,0.13)'); pg2.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,170,80,0)');
    x.fillStyle=pg2; x.beginPath(); x.arc(px2,py2,pr2,0,Math.PI*2); x.fill();
  }
  // grease slicks (yellow blobs in grease band)
  var gy0=zToY(18), gy1=zToY(-2);
  for(var g2=0;g2<26;g2++){
    x.fillStyle='rgba(255,210,60,'+(0.18+Math.random()*0.25)+')';
    x.beginPath(); x.ellipse(Math.random()*W, gy0+Math.random()*(gy1-gy0),
      12+Math.random()*30, 8+Math.random()*18, Math.random()*3, 0, Math.PI*2); x.fill();
  }
  // ember cracks (orange lines in slag band)
  x.strokeStyle='rgba(255,106,30,0.75)'; x.lineWidth=3;
  var sy0=zToY(-22), sy1=zToY(-42);
  for(var e2=0;e2<16;e2++){
    x.beginPath();
    var ex=Math.random()*W, ey=sy0+Math.random()*(sy1-sy0);
    x.moveTo(ex,ey);
    for(var s3=0;s3<4;s3++){ ex+=(Math.random()-0.5)*70; ey+=(Math.random()-0.5)*30; x.lineTo(ex,ey); }
    x.stroke();
  }
  // lava glow patches (volcano band)
  var vy0=zToY(-62), vy1=zToY(-118);
  for(var l2=0;l2<18;l2++){
    var lx=Math.random()*W, ly=vy0+Math.random()*(vy1-vy0), lr=14+Math.random()*36;
    var lg=x.createRadialGradient(lx,ly,2,lx,ly,lr);
    lg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,110,30,0.5)'); lg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,110,30,0)');
    x.fillStyle=lg; x.beginPath(); x.arc(lx,ly,lr,0,Math.PI*2); x.fill();
  }
  // center path: faint warm dashes down the middle
  x.strokeStyle='rgba(255,180,90,0.16)'; x.lineWidth=8; x.setLineDash([30,26]);
  x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(W/2,0); x.lineTo(W/2,H); x.stroke();
  var t=tex(c); t.anisotropy=4;
  return t;
}

function addCollider(x,z,r){ colliders.push({x:x,z:z,r:r}); }

function prop(geo, mat, x, y, z, ry, colliderR){
  var m=new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
  m.position.set(x,y,z);

  if(colliderR) addCollider(x,z,colliderR);

}

/* =====================================================================
   FBF — Fire Babys Fire: flammable world props, ignition, wind spread,
   burning damage, and hero-tool extinguish / flare-up (fire-safety tie-in).
   LOCAL visual-only system. Does not touch netcode or auth.
   ===================================================================== */
var FBF={
  list:[],
  wind:{x:1,z:0,speed:1},
  windT:12, windArrow:'\u2192 E', windDirty:true, lastFlareToast:0,
  /* register a flammable prop. opts: r, fuel, size, kind('A'|'B'), group,
     mats, y, torch, burning, flames, spreadMult */
  register:function(x,z,opts){
    if(this.list.length>=60) return null;
    var o=opts||{};
    var it={
      x:x, z:z,
      r:o.r||2, fuel:(o.fuel===Infinity?Infinity:(o.fuel||20)),
      maxFuel:(o.fuel===Infinity?Infinity:(o.fuel||20)),
      size:o.size||2, kind:o.kind||'A',
      group:o.group||null, mats:o.mats||[], y:o.y||2,
      spreadMult:o.spreadMult||1,
      torch:!!o.torch,
      burning:false, saved:false, burned:false,
      flames:[], embT:Math.random()*0.15, spreadT:0.3+Math.random()*0.4,
      dmgT:Math.random()*0.5, spreadBoostT:0, reigniteT:0
    };
    if(!it.group){ it.group=new THREE.Group(); it.group.position.set(x,0,z); scene.add(it.group); }
    if(o.flames&&o.flames.length){
      it.flames=o.flames;
      for(var f=0;f<it.flames.length;f++){ it.flames[f].userData.bx=0; it.flames[f].userData.bz=0; }
    }
    if(o.burning){ it.burning=true; if(it.flames.length===0) this.attachFlames(it); }
    this.list.push(it);
    return it;
  },
  attachFlames:function(it){
    if(typeof FLAME_TEX==='undefined'||!FLAME_TEX||!GLOW_TEX) return;
    var g=it.group, s=it.size;
    var fl=new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({map:FLAME_TEX,blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending,depthWrite:false,transparent:true}));
    fl.scale.set(s*0.9,s*1.3,1); fl.position.y=it.y;
    fl.userData.bx=0; fl.userData.bz=0; g.add(fl);
    var gl=new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({map:GLOW_TEX,blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending,depthWrite:false,transparent:true,opacity:0.6}));
    gl.scale.set(s*2.4,s*2.4,1); gl.position.y=it.y;
    gl.userData.bx=0; gl.userData.bz=0; g.add(gl);
    it.flames=[fl,gl];
  },
  /* ignite every unburned flammable within radius of (x,z) */
  ignite:function(x,z,radius){
    for(var i=0;i<this.list.length;i++){
      var it=this.list[i];
      if(it.burning||it.saved||it.burned) continue;
      var dx=it.x-x, dz=it.z-z;
      if(dx*dx+dz*dz<=radius*radius) this.igniteItem(it);
    }
  },
  igniteItem:function(it){
    if(it.burning||it.saved||it.burned) return;
    it.burning=true;
    if(it.flames.length===0) this.attachFlames(it);
    else for(var i=0;i<it.flames.length;i++) it.flames[i].visible=true;
    it.spreadT=0.3+Math.random()*0.4;
    if(typeof spawnBurst==='function')
      spawnBurst(new THREE.Vector3(it.x,it.y+0.5,it.z),0xffa040,6,4);
  },
  charItem:function(it,prog){
    if(prog<0) prog=0; if(prog>1) prog=1;
    for(var i=0;i<it.mats.length;i++){
      var m=it.mats[i];
      if(!m||!m.color) continue;
      if(m.userData._fbfOrig===undefined) m.userData._fbfOrig=m.color.getHex();
      var o=m.userData._fbfOrig;
      var or=(o>>16)&255, og=(o>>8)&255, ob=o&255;
      m.color.setRGB((or+(0x1a-or)*prog)/255,(og+(0x12-og)*prog)/255,(ob+(0x10-ob)*prog)/255);
    }
  },
  burnout:function(it){
    it.burning=false; it.burned=true;
    for(var i=0;i<it.flames.length;i++) it.flames[i].visible=false;
    this.charItem(it,1);
  },
  extinguish:function(it,byPlayer){
    if(!it.burning) return;
    it.burning=false; it.saved=true;
    for(var i=0;i<it.flames.length;i++) it.flames[i].visible=false;
    if(it.torch) it.reigniteT=20; // decorative torches relight themselves
    if(byPlayer){
      if(typeof showToast==='function') showToast('\uD83E\uDDEF EXTINGUISHED! +50',1400);
      if(typeof beep==='function') beep(880,0.15,'sine',0.08);
      try{
        if(window.FBMultiplayer&&typeof window.FBMultiplayer.sendExtinguish==='function')
          window.FBMultiplayer.sendExtinguish(it.x,it.z);
      }catch(e){}
    }
  },
  reignite:function(it){
    it.saved=false; it.burning=true; it.reigniteT=0;
    for(var i=0;i<it.flames.length;i++) it.flames[i].visible=true;
  },
  /* hero attack near fire: right tool extinguishes, wrong tool flares up */
  combatHit:function(pos,src){
    var heroId=src&&src.spec?src.spec.id:null;
    if(!heroId||typeof HERO_COUNTER==='undefined') return;
    var counter=HERO_COUNTER[heroId], weak=HERO_WEAK[heroId];
    for(var i=0;i<this.list.length;i++){
      var it=this.list[i];
      if(!it.burning) continue;
      var dx=it.x-pos.x, dz=it.z-pos.z;
      if(dx*dx+dz*dz>36) continue; // within 6
      if(counter&&counter===it.kind){
        this.extinguish(it,true);
      }else if(weak&&weak===it.kind){
        it.spreadBoostT=6; // doubles spread radius + chance for 6s
        var now=(typeof performance!=='undefined')?performance.now():0;
        if(now-this.lastFlareToast>1500){
          this.lastFlareToast=now;
          if(typeof showToast==='function') showToast('\uD83D\uDD25 FLARE-UP! Wrong tool!',1400);
          if(typeof beep==='function') beep(140,0.25,'sawtooth',0.09);
        }
      }
      /* blaze (no counter/weak): does nothing to fires */
    }
  },
  newWind:function(){
    var a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
    this.wind.x=Math.cos(a); this.wind.z=Math.sin(a);
    this.wind.speed=0.5+Math.random()*1.0;
    var dirs=['\u2192 E','\u2198 SE','\u2193 S','\u2199 SW','\u2190 W','\u2196 NW','\u2191 N','\u2197 NE'];
    this.windArrow=dirs[Math.round(a/(Math.PI/4))%8];
    this.windT=25+Math.random()*20;
    this.windDirty=true;
  },
  updateWindPill:function(){
    if(!this.windDirty) return;
    this.windDirty=false;
    var el=document.getElementById('windpill');
    if(el) el.textContent='\uD83D\uDCA8 WIND '+this.windArrow;
  },
  spreadFrom:function(src){
    var boost=src.spreadBoostT>0?2:1;
    var baseR=7*src.spreadMult*boost;
    for(var i=0;i<this.list.length;i++){
      var it=this.list[i];
      if(it.burning||it.saved||it.burned||it===src) continue;
      var dx=it.x-src.x, dz=it.z-src.z;
      var d2=dx*dx+dz*dz;
      if(d2>baseR*baseR||d2<0.01) continue;
      var d=Math.sqrt(d2);
      var align=(dx/d)*this.wind.x+(dz/d)*this.wind.z; // -1..1, downwind>0
      var chance=(0.35+0.4*align)*0.5*boost;
      if(Math.random()<chance) this.igniteItem(it);
    }
    if(src.spreadBoostT>0) src.spreadBoostT-=0.5;
  },
  burnFoes:function(it){
    if(typeof units==='undefined') return;
    var rr=(it.r+3)*(it.r+3);
    for(var i=0;i<units.length;i++){
      var u=units[i];
      if(!u||u.side!=='foe'||u.dead||!u.group) continue;
      var dx=u.group.position.x-it.x, dz=u.group.position.z-it.z;
      if(dx*dx+dz*dz>rr) continue;
      u.hp-=3;
      u.group.userData.flash=1;
      if(u.hpbar&&u.maxHp) u.hpbar.set(Math.max(0,u.hp/u.maxHp),true);
      if(typeof dmgNumber==='function')
        dmgNumber(u.group.position.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0,2,0)),3,'#ff6a5a');
      if(u.hp<=0&&!u.dead){
        u.dead=true; u.state='dying'; u.deathT=0;
        if(typeof fbExtinguishPoof==='function') fbExtinguishPoof(u.group);
        if(typeof spawnBurst==='function')
          spawnBurst(u.group.position.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0)),0xff8c2e,16,6);
        if(typeof updateFoeCount==='function') updateFoeCount();
      }
    }
  },
  update:function(dt){
    this.windT-=dt;
    if(this.windT<=0) this.newWind();
    for(var i=0;i<this.list.length;i++){
      var it=this.list[i];
      if(it.burning&&!it.saved){
        if(it.fuel!==Infinity) it.fuel-=dt;
        it.embT-=dt;
        if(it.embT<=0){
          it.embT=0.15;
          if(typeof spawnBurst==='function')
            spawnBurst(new THREE.Vector3(it.x,it.y+1,it.z),0xff8c2e,2,3);
        }
        var prog=(it.fuel===Infinity)?0:(1-it.fuel/it.maxFuel);
        this.charItem(it,prog);
        /* wind tilts the flames */
        for(var f=0;f<it.flames.length;f++){
          var flm=it.flames[f];
          flm.position.x=(flm.userData.bx||0)+this.wind.x*0.5*this.wind.speed;
          flm.position.z=(flm.userData.bz||0)+this.wind.z*0.5*this.wind.speed;
        }
        it.spreadT-=dt;
        if(it.spreadT<=0){ it.spreadT=0.5; this.spreadFrom(it); }
        it.dmgT-=dt;
        if(it.dmgT<=0){ it.dmgT=0.5; this.burnFoes(it); }
        if(it.fuel<=0) this.burnout(it);
      }else if(it.reigniteT>0){
        it.reigniteT-=dt;
        if(it.reigniteT<=0) this.reignite(it);
      }
    }
    this.updateWindPill();
  }
};

/* ---------------- particles, damage numbers, hp bars ---------------- */
var particles=[];
/* pooled particles: bounded sprite reuse, zero per-frame alloc/dispose.
   Two pools (additive bursts vs normal smoke) so blending never toggles. */
var particlePoolAdd=[], particlePoolNorm=[];
function poolGet(additive){
  var pool=additive?particlePoolAdd:particlePoolNorm;
  for(var i=0;i<pool.length;i++) if(!pool[i].visible) return pool[i];
  if(pool.length>=(additive?160:80)) return null;
  var s=new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map:GLOW_TEX, depthWrite:false, transparent:true,
    blending:additive?THREE.AdditiveBlending:THREE.NormalBlending }));
  s.visible=false; s.userData={}; scene.add(s); pool.push(s); return s;
}
function poolSpawn(pos, colorHex, additive, n, spd, smoke){
  n=Math.max(1,Math.round((n||10)*FBQ.particleScale)); spd=spd||4;
  for(var i=0;i<n;i++){
    var s=poolGet(additive); if(!s) return;
    s.visible=true; s.material.color.setHex(colorHex); s.material.opacity=0.9;
    s.position.copy(pos);
    var spread=smoke?1.4:0.6;
    s.position.x+=(Math.random()-0.5)*spread; s.position.z+=(Math.random()-0.5)*spread;
    var sc=smoke?(0.7+Math.random()*0.9):(0.5+Math.random()*0.9); s.scale.set(sc,sc,1);
    var u=s.userData, vspd=smoke?1.6:spd;
    u.vx=(Math.random()-0.5)*vspd; u.vy=smoke?(1.6+Math.random()*2.4):(Math.random()*spd*0.9+1); u.vz=(Math.random()-0.5)*vspd;
    u.life=smoke?(0.9+Math.random()*0.7):(0.55+Math.random()*0.35); u.age=0; u.smoke=!!smoke;
    particles.push(s);
  }
}
function spawnBurst(pos, colorHex, n, spd){ poolSpawn(pos, colorHex, true, n, spd, false); }
function updateParticles(dt){
  for(var i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    var p=particles[i], u=p.userData;
    u.age+=dt;
    if(u.age>=u.life){ p.visible=false; particles.splice(i,1); continue; }
    p.position.x+=u.vx*dt; p.position.y+=u.vy*dt; p.position.z+=u.vz*dt;
    var k=1-u.age/u.life;
    if(u.smoke){
      u.vy+=1.2*dt;
      p.material.opacity=k*0.8; p.scale.multiplyScalar(1+dt*1.7);
    } else {
      u.vy-=6*dt;
      p.material.opacity=k; p.scale.multiplyScalar(1-dt*0.6);
    }
  }
}

var dmgPool=[];
function dmgNumber(pos, amount, color){
  var d=null;
  for(var i=0;i<dmgPool.length;i++) if(!dmgPool[i].visible){ d=dmgPool[i]; break; }
  if(!d){
    if(dmgPool.length>24) return;
    var c=cnv(128,64), t=tex(c);
    var sp=new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map:t, depthWrite:false, transparent:true }));
    sp.scale.set(2.4,1.2,1); sp.visible=false; sp.userData={c:c,t:t};
    scene.add(sp); dmgPool.push(sp); d=sp;
  }
  var x=d.userData.c.getContext('2d');
  x.clearRect(0,0,128,64);
  x.font='900 40px system-ui,sans-serif'; x.textAlign='center'; x.textBaseline='middle';
  x.lineWidth=7; x.strokeStyle='rgba(20,5,0,0.9)';
  var txt='-'+amount;
  x.strokeText(txt,64,32); x.fillStyle=color||'#ffd76a'; x.fillText(txt,64,32);
  d.userData.t.needsUpdate=true;
  d.position.copy(pos); d.position.y+=1.6;
  d.visible=true; d.userData.age=0; d.userData.life=0.9;
}
function updateDmg(dt){
  for(var i=0;i<dmgPool.length;i++){
    var d=dmgPool[i]; if(!d.visible) continue;
    d.userData.age+=dt;
    if(d.userData.age>=d.userData.life){ d.visible=false; continue; }
    d.position.y+=dt*2.4;
    d.material.opacity=1-d.userData.age/d.userData.life;
  }
}

function makeHpBar(w){
  var grp=new THREE.Group();
  var bg=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w,0.22),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color:0x1a0a06, depthWrite:false, transparent:true, opacity:0.85 }));
  var fg=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w,0.22),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color:0x7dff6a, depthWrite:false, transparent:true }));
  fg.position.z=0.01;
  grp.add(bg); grp.add(fg);
  grp.userData={fg:fg,w:w};
  grp.set=function(frac, hurt){

  return grp;
}

function makeVillain(name, cls, scale){
  scale=scale||1;
  var g=new THREE.Group();
  var R=1.05*scale;
  var spec={ body:'#3a241a', dark:'#120806', core:CLASSES[cls].color };
  var body=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(R,20,14),
    new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map:bodyTexture(spec,'villain') }));
  body.rotation.y = -Math.PI/2;
  g.add(body);
  var glow=new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map:GLOW_TEX, color:CLASSES[cls].hex,
    blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite:false, transparent:true, opacity:0.7 }));
  glow.scale.set(R*4,R*4,1); g.add(glow);
  var licks=[];
  var lm=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map:FLAME_TEX, color:CLASSES[cls].hex, transparent:true,
    blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite:false, side:THREE.DoubleSide });
  for(var i=0;i<6;i++){
    var cone=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(R*0.3,R*1.0,6), lm);
    var a=(i/6)*Math.PI*2;
    cone.position.set(Math.cos(a)*R*0.7, Math.sin(a)*R*0.7, R*0.3);
    cone.rotation.z=a-Math.PI/2;
    cone.userData.phase=Math.random()*9; cone.userData.base=0.85+Math.random()*0.3;
    g.add(cone); licks.push(cone);
  }
  if(name==='inferno'){
    var hornMat=new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:0x1c0a05});
    [-1,1].forEach(function(s){
      var horn=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(R*0.22,R*0.8,7), hornMat);
      horn.position.set(s*R*0.55, R*0.95, 0); horn.rotation.z=-s*0.45;
      g.add(horn);
    });
  }
  var badge=classBadge(cls); badge.position.y=R*1.9; g.add(badge);
  var tag=nameTag(VILLAIN_NAMES[name]||name, CLASSES[cls].color); tag.position.y=R*2.6; g.add(tag);
  var blobC=cnv(64,64), blobX=blobC.getContext('2d');
  var bg=blobX.createRadialGradient(32,32,2,32,32,30);
  bg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0.42)'); bg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  blobX.fillStyle=bg; blobX.fillRect(0,0,64,64);
  var blob=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(R*2.6,R*2.6),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map:tex(blobC), transparent:true, depthWrite:false }));
  blob.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2; blob.position.y=-R*1.52; g.add(blob);
  g.userData={ licks:licks, R:R, body:body, glow:glow, blob:blob,
    bobPhase:Math.random()*9, flash:0, baseY:0, name:name };
  addLimbs(g, R, spec.body, spec.dark);
  return g;
}

var SPEAKER_NAMES={ narrator:'—', ruko:'RUKO', sizzle:'SIZZLE', cinder:'CINDER', boulder:'BOULDER', blaze:'BLAZE',
  twiggy:'TWIGGY', slick:'SLICK', buzz:'BUZZ', slag:'SLAG', inferno:'LORD INFERNO' };

function clearCast(){
  for(var i=0;i<castList.length;i++) scene.remove(castList[i].group);
  castList=[]; villainGroups=[];
}
/* stage the 5 heroes + optional villains around (x,z), facing +Z (camera side) */
function stageLineupAt(x, z, villains){
  clearCast();
  var xs=[-6,-3,0,3,6];
  for(var i=0;i<HEROES.length;i++){
    var grp=makeBaby(HEROES[i], HEROES[i].face, 1);
    grp.position.set(x+xs[i], 1.55, z);
    grp.userData.baseY=1.55;
    grp.rotation.y=Math.PI; // face +Z toward camera
    scene.add(grp);
    castList.push({who:HEROES[i].id, group:grp});
  }
  if(villains) stageVillains(villains, x, z-9);
  return castList;
}
/* stage villains in an arc facing the player; squad must already be in castList */
function stageVillains(villains, x, z){
  villains.forEach(function(v, k){
    var sc=v.boss?1.7:1.15;
    var vg=makeVillain(v.name, v.cls, sc);
    vg.position.set(x+(k-(villains.length-1)/2)*3.6, sc*1.55, z-k*1.2);
    vg.userData.baseY=sc*1.55;
    vg.rotation.y=0; // face +Z toward heroes/camera
    scene.add(vg);
    castList.push({who:v.name, group:vg});
    villainGroups.push(vg);
  });
}
function clearVillains(){
  for(var i=0;i<villainGroups.length;i++){
    scene.remove(villainGroups[i]);
    for(var j=castList.length-1;j>=0;j--)
      if(castList[j].group===villainGroups[i]) castList.splice(j,1);
  }
  villainGroups=[];
}
function castWho(who){
  for(var i=0;i<castList.length;i++) if(castList[i].who===who) return castList[i].group;
  return null;
}

function playCine(lines, onDone){
  cine={ lines:lines, i:-1, onDone:onDone||null, chars:0, full:'', done:true,
    camPos:new THREE.Vector3(), camTgt:new THREE.Vector3(0,1.5,0), init:false };
  document.getElementById('dlgov').style.display='block';
  cineAdvance();
}
function cineRender(){
  var line=cine.lines[cine.i];
  var nm=document.getElementById('dlgname'), tx=document.getElementById('dlgtext');
  if(line.who==='narrator'){
    nm.textContent='— WEST EMBER HIGH —'; nm.style.color='#8a6a5a';
    tx.className='narr';
  } else {
    nm.textContent=SPEAKER_NAMES[line.who]||line.who.toUpperCase(); nm.style.color='#ffd76a';
    tx.className='';
  }
  cine.full=line.text; cine.chars=0; cine.done=false; tx.textContent='';
  var spk=castWho(line.who);
  var tp=new THREE.Vector3(), pp=new THREE.Vector3();
  if(spk){
    tp.copy(spk.position); tp.y+=1.2;
    // camera in front of speaker (speaker faces +Z, so camera sits at +Z)
    pp.copy(spk.position).add(new THREE.Vector3(2.8, 2.2, 6.4));
  } else { tp.set(0,1.6,30); pp.set(0,5.5,44); }
  cine.camTgt.copy(tp); cine.camPos.copy(pp);
  if(!cine.init){ camera.position.copy(pp); cine.init=true; }
  for(var i=0;i<castList.length;i++){
    var g2=castList[i].group, isSpk=(castList[i].who===line.who);
    g2.userData.glow.material.opacity=isSpk?1.0:0.4;
    g2.scale.setScalar(isSpk?1.14:1.0);
  }
}
function cineAdvance(){
  if(!cine) return;
  var tx=document.getElementById('dlgtext');
  if(!cine.done){ tx.textContent=cine.full; tx.className = cine.lines[cine.i].who==='narrator'?'narr':''; cine.done=true; return; }
  cine.i++;
  if(cine.i>=cine.lines.length){ cineFinish(); return; }
  cineRender();
}
function cineFinish(){
  if(!cine) return;
  document.getElementById('dlgov').style.display='none';
  for(var i=0;i<castList.length;i++){
    castList[i].group.scale.setScalar(1.0);
    castList[i].group.userData.glow.material.opacity=0.85;
  }
  var cb=cine.onDone; cine=null;
  if(cb) cb();
}
var cineLook=new THREE.Vector3(0,1.5,0);
function updateCine(t, dt){
  if(!cine) return;
  if(!cine.done){
    cine.chars+=dt*62;
    var n=Math.min(cine.full.length, Math.floor(cine.chars));
    var tx=document.getElementById('dlgtext');
    if(tx.textContent.length!==n) tx.textContent=cine.full.slice(0,n);
    if(n>=cine.full.length) cine.done=true;
  }
  camera.position.lerp(cine.camPos, 1-Math.pow(0.02, dt));
  cineLook.lerp(cine.camTgt, 1-Math.pow(0.02, dt));
  camera.lookAt(cineLook);
  for(var i=0;i<castList.length;i++) updateBaby(castList[i].group, t, dt);
}

/* ---------------- input: virtual joystick + WASD ---------------- */
var joy={dx:0, dy:0, active:false, id:null};
var keys={};
function bindInput(){
  var joyEl=document.getElementById('joy'), knob=document.getElementById('knob');
  function setKnob(dx,dy){
    knob.style.transform='translate(calc(-50% + '+dx+'px), calc(-50% + '+dy+'px))';
  }
  joyEl.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e){
    joy.active=true; joy.id=e.pointerId;
    try { joyEl.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch(_e){}
    joyMove(e);
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
  }, {passive:false});
  function joyMove(e){
    if(!joy.active||e.pointerId!==joy.id) return;
    var r=joyEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    var cx=r.left+r.width/2, cy=r.top+r.height/2;
    var dx=e.clientX-cx, dy=e.clientY-cy;
    var max=r.width/2-14, len=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
    if(len>max){ dx=dx/len*max; dy=dy/len*max; }
    joy.dx=dx/max; joy.dy=dy/max;
    setKnob(dx,dy);
  }
  joyEl.addEventListener('pointermove', joyMove);
  function joyEnd(e){
    if(e.pointerId!==joy.id) return;
    joy.active=false; joy.id=null; joy.dx=0; joy.dy=0; setKnob(0,0);
  }
  joyEl.addEventListener('pointerup', joyEnd);
  joyEl.addEventListener('pointercancel', joyEnd);

  window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    var k=(e.key||'').toLowerCase();
    if(cine){
      if(k===' '||k==='enter'){ cineAdvance(); e.preventDefault(); }
      else if(k==='escape'||k==='s'){ cineFinish(); e.preventDefault(); }
      return;
    }
    if(k==='w'||k==='a'||k==='s'||k==='d'||k==='arrowup'||k==='arrowdown'||k==='arrowleft'||k==='arrowright'){
      keys[k]=true; e.preventDefault();
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', function(e){ keys[(e.key||'').toLowerCase()]=false; });

  var cv=renderer.domElement;
  cv.addEventListener('wheel', function(e){
    camDistMul=Math.max(0.75,Math.min(1.35,camDistMul+e.deltaY*0.001));
    e.preventDefault();
  }, {passive:false});

  window.addEventListener('resize', function(){
    camera.aspect=innerWidth/innerHeight; camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    renderer.setSize(innerWidth,innerHeight);
  });

  /* TAP TO START is wired by the standalone script before </body> (independent of init/bindInput) */
  document.getElementById('pstart').addEventListener('click', function(){ saveCreation(); });
  document.getElementById('againbtn').addEventListener('click', function(){
    document.getElementById('victoryov').style.display='none';
    if(onVictoryNext) onVictoryNext(); else showHub();
  });
  document.getElementById('retrybtn').addEventListener('click', function(){
    document.getElementById('defeatov').style.display='none';
    if(onDefeatNext) onDefeatNext(); else showHub();
  });
  document.getElementById('vhubbtn').addEventListener('click', function(){
    document.getElementById('victoryov').style.display='none'; showHub();
  });
  document.getElementById('dhubbtn').addEventListener('click', function(){
    document.getElementById('defeatov').style.display='none'; showHub();
  });
  document.getElementById('lbback').addEventListener('click', function(){
    document.getElementById('lbov').style.display='none'; showHub();
  });
  document.getElementById('tab_top').addEventListener('click', function(){ renderLB('top'); });
  document.getElementById('tab_champ').addEventListener('click', function(){ renderLB('champions'); });
}

function resolveColliders(u, nx, nz){
  for(var i=0;i<colliders.length;i++){
    var c=colliders[i];
    var dx=nx-c.x, dz=nz-c.z, d=Math.hypot(dx,dz), min=c.r+0.9;
    if(d<min&&d>0.001){ nx=c.x+dx/d*min; nz=c.z+dz/d*min; }
  }
  return {x:nx, z:nz};
}
function gateBlocked(ox, oz, nx, nz){
  for(var i=0;i<gates.length;i++){
    var g=gates[i];
    if(!g.locked) continue;
    if(Math.abs(nx)>9.5) continue; // can walk around the sides? no — corridor walls; keep simple
    if((oz-g.z)*(nz-g.z)<0){ return g.z; }
  }
  return null;
}

var camDistMul=1;
function moveInput(){
  var vx=0, vz=0;
  if(joy.active){ vx+=joy.dx; vz+=joy.dy; }
  if(keys['w']||keys['arrowup']) vz-=1;
  if(keys['s']||keys['arrowdown']) vz+=1;
  if(keys['a']||keys['arrowleft']) vx-=1;
  if(keys['d']||keys['arrowright']) vx+=1;
  var l=Math.hypot(vx,vz);
  if(l>1){ vx/=l; vz/=l; }
  return {x:vx, z:vz, on:l>0.08};
}

function updateExplore(dt, t){
  var mv=moveInput();
  var bp=player.group.position;
  if(mv.on){
    var sp=7.5*dt;
    var nx=bp.x+mv.x*sp, nz=bp.z+mv.z*sp;
    // gates
    var gz=gateBlocked(bp.x, bp.z, nx, nz);
    if(gz!==null){ nz=gz+(bp.z>gz?0.6:-0.6); nx=bp.x; }
    // world bounds
    nx=Math.max(-26,Math.min(26,nx)); nz=Math.max(-108,Math.min(44,nz));
    var rc=resolveColliders(player, nx, nz);
    bp.x=rc.x; bp.z=rc.z;
    player.group.rotation.y=Math.atan2(mv.x, mv.z);
    beepTick+=dt;
  }
  updateBaby(player.group, t, dt);

  // followers: drift to formation slots
  followers.forEach(function(f){
    var off=null;
    for(var k=0;k<FOLLOW_OFF.length;k++) if(FOLLOW_OFF[k].id===f.spec.id) off=FOLLOW_OFF[k];
    var tx=bp.x+off.dx, tz=bp.z+off.dz;
    var fp=f.group.position;
    var dx=tx-fp.x, dz=tz-fp.z, d=Math.hypot(dx,dz);
    if(d>0.7){
      var fs=Math.min(f.speed, d*3.2)*dt;
      fp.x+=dx/d*fs; fp.z+=dz/d*fs;
      f.group.rotation.y=Math.atan2(dx,dz);
    }
    updateBaby(f.group, t, dt);
    f.hpbar.quaternion.copy(camera.quaternion);
  });
  player.hpbar.quaternion.copy(camera.quaternion);

  // follow camera
  var cx=bp.x*0.55, cz=bp.z+13.5*camDistMul, cy=10.5*camDistMul;
  camera.position.lerp(new THREE.Vector3(cx,cy,cz), 1-Math.pow(0.01,dt));
  camera.lookAt(bp.x*0.6, 1.5, bp.z-5);

  // fog follows biome
  var pz=bp.z, fogT=BIOMES[0].fog;
  for(var b=0;b<BIOMES.length;b++) if(pz<=BIOMES[b].z0&&pz>BIOMES[b].z1) fogT=BIOMES[b].fog;
  scene.fog.color.lerp(new THREE.Color(fogT), 1-Math.pow(0.2,dt));
  document.getElementById('stagepill').textContent='🔥 '+biomeNameAt(pz).toUpperCase();

  // town trigger zones (story mode only)
  if(!cine && state==='EXPLORE' && gameMode==='story'){
    for(var i=0;i<TOWNS.length;i++){
      if(liberated[i]) continue;
      var tr=TOWNS[i].trig;
      var ddx=bp.x-tr.x, ddz=bp.z-tr.z;
      if(ddx*ddx+ddz*ddz<tr.r*tr.r){ enterTown(i); break; }
    }
  }
  // random encounters: wild fire-monsters every 7-15 steps of travel
  if(!cine && state==='EXPLORE' && (gameMode==='story'||gameMode==='free')){
    var moved=Math.hypot(bp.x-lastPX, bp.z-lastPZ);
    stepAcc+=moved; lastPX=bp.x; lastPZ=bp.z;
    if(stepAcc>nextEncounter){
      stepAcc=0; nextEncounter=(7+Math.random()*8)*2.5;
      startEncounter();
    }
  }
}
var beepTick=0;
function biomeNameAt(z){
  for(var b=0;b<BIOMES.length;b++) if(z<=BIOMES[b].z0&&z>BIOMES[b].z1) return BIOMES[b].id==='ember'?'Ember Village':TOWNS[b].name;
  return TOWNS[0].name;
}

var strongHP=0, strongMax=0;

function spawnFoes(comp, cx, cz){
  comp.forEach(function(f, i){
    var boss=f[4]==='boss';
    var key=f[0].toLowerCase();
    if(key.indexOf('inferno')>=0) key='inferno';
    var g=makeVillain(key, f[1], boss?1.7:1.0);
    var R=g.userData.R;
    var a=(i/comp.length)*Math.PI*2+0.4, rr=8+Math.random()*2;
    g.position.set(cx+Math.cos(a)*rr, R*1.55, cz+Math.sin(a)*rr*0.7);
    g.userData.baseY=R*1.55;
    var hp=makeHpBar(boss?3.4:2.0); hp.position.y=R*2.1+0.9; g.add(hp); hp.set(1);
    scene.add(g);
    units.push({ group:g, side:'foe', name:f[0], cls:f[1], hp:f[2], maxHp:f[2],
      atk:f[3], speed:4.4+Math.random()*0.5, range:2.3, cd:Math.random()*0.8, hpbar:hp,
      state:'seek', dead:false, lunge:0, lungeDir:null, boss:boss });
  });
  updateFoeCount();
}
function updateFoeCount(){
  var n=0; for(var i=0;i<units.length;i++) if(units[i].side==='foe'&&!units[i].dead) n++;
  document.getElementById('foecount').textContent=n;
}
function nearestFoe(u){
  var best=null, bd=1e9;
  for(var i=0;i<units.length;i++){ var v=units[i];
    if(v.side==='foe'&&!v.dead){ var d=u.group.position.distanceTo(v.group.position);
      if(d<bd){ bd=d; best=v; } } }
  return best?{u:best,d:bd}:null;
}
function nearestHero(u){
  var best=null, bd=1e9;
  for(var i=0;i<units.length;i++){ var v=units[i];
    if(v.side==='hero'&&!v.dead){ var d=u.group.position.distanceTo(v.group.position);
      if(d<bd){ bd=d; best=v; } } }
  return best?{u:best,d:bd}:null;
}
/* HARD BOTS (2026-10-12): foes focus the weakest hero they can reach —
   if a hero within 16 units is clearly the most hurt (by HP fraction),
   finish that one; otherwise take the nearest, like before. Uses only
   visible info (positions + HP bars). */
function foePickTarget(u){
  var weak=null, wf=2, wd=1e9;
  for(var i=0;i<units.length;i++){ var v=units[i];
    if(v.side==='hero'&&!v.dead){ var d=u.group.position.distanceTo(v.group.position);
      if(d<16){ var f=v.hp/v.maxHp; if(f<wf){ wf=f; weak=v; wd=d; } } } }
  if(weak && wf<0.999) return {u:weak,d:wd};
  return nearestHero(u);
}
var HERO_COUNTER={ruko:'A', boulder:'D', sizzle:'C', cinder:'B'};
var HERO_WEAK={ruko:'B', boulder:'A', sizzle:'D', cinder:'C'};
var lastMatchToast=0;
function dealDamage(src, tgt, amount){
  if(tgt.dead) return;
  // Extinguish Matchup Matrix: correct counter = big damage, wrong = backfire
  if(src && src.side==='hero' && tgt.cls && src.spec && src.spec.id){
    var id=src.spec.id, mult=1, note=null;
    if(id==='blaze'){ mult=1.25; }
    else if(HERO_COUNTER[id]===tgt.cls){ mult=2; note='⚡ SUPER EFFECTIVE! '+src.spec.name+' counters Class '+tgt.cls; }
    else if(HERO_WEAK[id]===tgt.cls){ mult=0.5; note='💦 BACKFIRE! Wrong match for '+src.spec.name;
      src.hp=Math.max(1, src.hp-6); src.hpbar.set(src.hp/src.maxHp); }
    if(note && performance.now()-lastMatchToast>1500){ lastMatchToast=performance.now(); showToast(note, 1400); }
    amount=Math.round(amount*mult);
  }
  /* FBF fire spread: hero attacks ignite nearby flammables; hero tools vs fire */
  if(src && src.side==='hero' && typeof FBF!=='undefined' && tgt.group){
    FBF.ignite(tgt.group.position.x, tgt.group.position.z, 5);
    FBF.combatHit(tgt.group.position, src);
  }
  tgt.hp-=amount;
  tgt.group.userData.flash=1;
  tgt.hpbar.set(tgt.hp/tgt.maxHp, true);
  var p=tgt.group.position.clone();
  dmgNumber(p, Math.round(amount), src.side==='hero'?'#ffd76a':'#ff6a5a');
  spawnBurst(p.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0)), src.side==='hero'?0xffb347:0xff3a2a, 8, 4);
  beep(src.side==='hero'?300+Math.random()*120:180, 0.07, 'square', 0.05);
  if(tgt.hp<=0){
    tgt.dead=true; tgt.state='dying'; tgt.deathT=0;
    fbExtinguishPoof(tgt.group);
    spawnBurst(p.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0)), 0xff8c2e, 16, 6);
    if(tgt.side==='foe') updateFoeCount();
  }
}

function hitStronghold(amount){

function heroesAlive(){ var n=0; for(var i=0;i<units.length;i++) if(units[i].side==='hero'&&!units[i].dead) n++; return n; }

function updateBattle(dt, t){
  battleTime+=dt;
  var anyFoe=false;
  for(var i=0;i<units.length;i++){ var u=units[i]; if(u.side==='foe'&&!u.dead){anyFoe=true;break;} }

  for(var k=units.length-1;k>=0;k--){
    var u=units[k], g=u.group;
    if(u.dead){
      if(u.state==='dying'){
        u.deathT+=dt;
        g.position.y-=dt*2.2; g.scale.multiplyScalar(1-dt*1.6);
        if(u.deathT>0.7){ scene.remove(g); u.state='gone'; }
      }
      continue;
    }
    updateBaby(g, t, dt);
    u.cd-=dt;

    var tgt=null, dist=1e9, tgtPos=null;
    if(u.side==='hero'){
      var nf=nearestFoe(u);
      if(nf){ tgt=nf.u; dist=nf.d; tgtPos=tgt.group.position; }
      else if(strongHP>0){ tgtPos=new THREE.Vector3(stronghold.position.x,2,stronghold.position.z); dist=g.position.distanceTo(tgtPos); tgt='stronghold'; }
    } else {
      var nh=foePickTarget(u);
      if(nh){ tgt=nh.u; dist=nh.d; tgtPos=tgt.group.position; }
    }
    if(tgtPos){
      var dir=new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(tgtPos, g.position); dir.y=0;
      var dlen=dir.length(); if(dlen>0.001) dir.normalize();
      var reach=(tgt==='stronghold')?5.2:u.range;
      var driven=false;
      // Blaze can still be steered in battle (dodge!)
      if(u.isBlaze){
        var mv=moveInput();
        if(mv.on){
          g.position.x+=mv.x*u.speed*dt; g.position.z+=mv.z*u.speed*dt;
          g.rotation.y=Math.atan2(mv.x,mv.z);
          driven=true;
        }
      }
      if(!driven){
        if(dlen>reach){
          g.position.addScaledVector(dir, u.speed*dt);
          g.rotation.y=Math.atan2(dir.x, dir.z);
          u.state='seek';
        } else {
          g.rotation.y=Math.atan2(dir.x, dir.z);
          u.state='attack';
          if(u.cd<=0){
            u.cd=u.side==='hero'?(u.spec.id==='sizzle'?1.5:1.1):1.05;
            u.lunge=0.28; u.lungeDir=dir.clone();
            var dmg=u.atk*(0.85+Math.random()*0.3);
            if(tgt==='stronghold'){ hitStronghold(dmg); }
            else {
              if(u.side==='hero'&&u.spec.id==='cinder'){
                for(var j=0;j<units.length;j++){ var v=units[j];
                  if(v.side==='foe'&&!v.dead&&v.group.position.distanceTo(tgt.group.position)<3.4)
                    dealDamage(u, v, dmg*(v===tgt?1:0.6));
                }
              } else dealDamage(u, tgt, dmg);
            }
          }
        }
      } else if(dlen<=reach){
        // steering but in range: still attack
        g.rotation.y=Math.atan2(dir.x, dir.z);
        if(u.cd<=0){
          u.cd=1.1; u.lunge=0.28; u.lungeDir=dir.clone();
          var dmg2=u.atk*(0.85+Math.random()*0.3);
          if(tgt==='stronghold') hitStronghold(dmg2); else dealDamage(u, tgt, dmg2);
        }
      }
      if(u.lunge>0&&u.lungeDir){
        u.lunge-=dt;
        var k2=Math.sin((0.28-u.lunge)/0.28*Math.PI)*1.1;
        g.position.addScaledVector(u.lungeDir, k2*dt*8);
      }
      // stay in the arena
      var ax=g.position.x-arenaCenter.x, az=g.position.z-arenaCenter.z;
      var ad=Math.hypot(ax,az);
      if(ad>26){ g.position.x=arenaCenter.x+ax/ad*26; g.position.z=arenaCenter.z+az/ad*26; }
    }
    u.hpbar.quaternion.copy(camera.quaternion);
  }

  if(strongFire.visible){
    for(var f=0;f<strongFire.children.length;f++){
      var cf=strongFire.children[f];
      var s=0.85+0.35*Math.sin(t*10+cf.userData.ph);
      cf.scale.set(1.6*s,2.4*s,1);
    }
    if(Math.random()<dt*8){
      var sp2=stronghold.position;
      spawnBurst(new THREE.Vector3(sp2.x+(Math.random()-0.5)*5,8.6,sp2.z),0xff6a1e,2,2);
    }
  }

  // battle camera: 3/4 view over the arena
  var dist=21*camDistMul, h=13.5*camDistMul;
  camera.position.set(arenaCenter.x, h, arenaCenter.z+dist);
  camera.lookAt(arenaCenter.x, 1, arenaCenter.z-2);

  if(heroesAlive()===0 && state==='BATTLE') defeat();
  // victory when every foe is down (encounter / practice / tournament: no stronghold)
  if(state==='BATTLE' && battleKind!=='town' && battleKind!=='rescue' && !(battleKind==='survival'&&survBetween)){
    var anyFoeLeft=false;
    for(var i2=0;i2<units.length;i2++) if(units[i2].side==='foe' && !units[i2].dead){ anyFoeLeft=true; break; }
    if(!anyFoeLeft) victory();
  }
}

function openGate(townIdx){

    sy+=0.25; grp.position.y=-sy;
    if(sy>7){ clearInterval(sink); scene.remove(grp); }
  }, 40);
  beep(660,0.2,'square',0.08);
}
function applyLiberated(){
  for(var i=0;i<6;i++) if(liberated[i]&&gates[i]){ gates[i].locked=false; scene.remove(gates[i].grp); }
}
function clearArena(){
  for(var i=units.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    if(units[i].side==='foe'){ scene.remove(units[i].group); units.splice(i,1); }
    else { // heal + revive squad
      var u=units[i];
      u.dead=false; u.state='idle'; u.hp=u.maxHp; u.hpbar.set(1);
      u.group.scale.setScalar(1);
      u.group.position.y=u.group.userData.baseY;
    }
  }
  // regroup squad around Blaze
  var bp=player.group.position;
  followers.forEach(function(f){
    for(var k=0;k<FOLLOW_OFF.length;k++) if(FOLLOW_OFF[k].id===f.spec.id){
      f.group.position.set(bp.x+FOLLOW_OFF[k].dx, 1.05, bp.z+FOLLOW_OFF[k].dz);
    }
  });
  updateFoeCount();
}

function saveLevels(){
  try{
    var o={};
    units.forEach(function(u){ if(u.side==='hero')
      o[u.spec.id]={level:u.level,exp:u.exp,expNext:u.expNext,maxHp:u.maxHp,atk:u.atk}; });
    localStorage.setItem('fb3d_levels', JSON.stringify(o));
  }catch(e){}

function loadLevels(){

    return JSON.parse(raw); }catch(e){ return null; }

function grantExpAll(amount){
  var ups=[];
  units.forEach(function(u){
    if(u.side!=='hero') return;
    u.exp+=amount;
    while(u.exp>=u.expNext){
      u.exp-=u.expNext; u.level++;
      u.expNext=100*u.level;
      u.maxHp=Math.round(u.maxHp*1.12); u.atk=Math.round(u.atk*1.10);
      u.hp=u.maxHp; u.hpbar.set(1);
      ups.push(u.spec.name+'→Lv'+u.level);
    }
  });
  saveLevels(); updateExpBar();
  addTotalExp(amount*5);
  if(ups.length) showToast('⬆️ LEVEL UP! '+ups.slice(0,2).join(', ')+(ups.length>2?' +'+(ups.length-2)+' more':''));
}
function updateExpBar(){

function avgSquadLevel(){
  var s=0,n=0;
  units.forEach(function(u){ if(u.side==='hero'){ s+=u.level; n++; } });

}

var rescues=[], rescueFires=[], rescueTime=0, rescueSaved=0, rescueLastSec=-1;
function clearRescueProps(){
  for(var i=0;i<rescues.length;i++) scene.remove(rescues[i].group);
  for(var f=0;f<rescueFires.length;f++) scene.remove(rescueFires[f].mesh);

function startRescue(){
  gameMode='rescue'; modeEnter();
  createSquad(0, 40);
  state='BATTLE'; battleKind='rescue'; battleTime=0;
  arenaCenter.set(0,0,30);
  hideStronghold(); strongHP=0;
  clearRescueProps();
  rescueSaved=0; rescueTime=90; rescueLastSec=-1;
  for(var k=0;k<5;k++){
    var g=makeBaby({body:'#ffd76a', dark:'#a35a00', core:'#fff7c0'}, 'eager', 0.55);
    var a=(k/5)*Math.PI*2+0.3, rr=10+Math.random()*8;
    g.position.set(arenaCenter.x+Math.cos(a)*rr, 0.85, arenaCenter.z+Math.sin(a)*rr*0.7);
    g.userData.baseY=0.85;
    var tag=nameTag('HELP!', '#ffd76a'); tag.position.y=1.7; g.add(tag);
    scene.add(g);
    rescues.push({group:g, tag:tag, saved:false});
  }
  for(var q=0;q<4;q++){
    var fa=(q/4)*Math.PI*2+0.9, fr=13+Math.random()*6;
    var fx=arenaCenter.x+Math.cos(fa)*fr, fz=arenaCenter.z+Math.sin(fa)*fr*0.7;
    var fm=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(2.2, 20),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xff5a1e, transparent:true, opacity:0.55, depthWrite:false}));
    fm.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2; fm.position.set(fx, 0.06, fz);
    scene.add(fm);
    rescueFires.push({mesh:fm, x:fx, z:fz, r:2.2});
  }
  document.getElementById('foepill').style.display='none';
  setObjective('\uD83D\uDEA8 RESCUE 0/5 PUPS \u2014 90s!');
  townBanner('RESCUE MODE', 'SAVE THE EMBER-PUPS!', 1600);
}
function updateRescue(dt, t){
  battleTime+=dt;
  rescueTime-=dt;
  var sec=Math.ceil(Math.max(0,rescueTime));
  if(sec!==rescueLastSec){ rescueLastSec=sec; setObjective('\uD83D\uDEA8 RESCUE '+rescueSaved+'/5 PUPS \u2014 '+sec+'s!'); }
  if(rescueTime<=0){ defeat(); return; }
  var bp=player.group.position;
  var mv=moveInput(), sp=7.5;
  if(mv.on){
    bp.x=Math.max(arenaCenter.x-26, Math.min(arenaCenter.x+26, bp.x+mv.x*sp*dt));
    bp.z=Math.max(arenaCenter.z-26, Math.min(arenaCenter.z+26, bp.z+mv.z*sp*dt));
    player.group.rotation.y=Math.atan2(mv.x, mv.z);
  }
  updateBaby(player.group, t, dt);
  followers.forEach(function(f){
    var off=null;
    for(var k=0;k<FOLLOW_OFF.length;k++) if(FOLLOW_OFF[k].id===f.spec.id) off=FOLLOW_OFF[k];
    var tx=bp.x+off.dx, tz=bp.z+off.dz, fp=f.group.position;
    var dx=tx-fp.x, dz=tz-fp.z, d=Math.hypot(dx,dz);
    if(d>0.7){ var fs=Math.min(f.speed, d*3.2)*dt; fp.x+=dx/d*fs; fp.z+=dz/d*fs; f.group.rotation.y=Math.atan2(dx,dz); }
    updateBaby(f.group, t, dt);
    f.hpbar.quaternion.copy(camera.quaternion);
  });
  player.hpbar.quaternion.copy(camera.quaternion);
  var i, dx2, dz2;
  for(i=0;i<rescues.length;i++){
    var r=rescues[i];
    if(r.saved) continue;
    updateBaby(r.group, t, dt);
    dx2=bp.x-r.group.position.x; dz2=bp.z-r.group.position.z;
    if(dx2*dx2+dz2*dz2 < 2.2*2.2){
      r.saved=true; rescueSaved++;
      r.group.remove(r.tag);
      spawnBurst(r.group.position.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0)), 0xffd76a, 16, 6);
      beep(880,0.15,'square',0.08);
      showToast('\uD83D\uDEA8 PUP RESCUED! '+rescueSaved+'/5', 1200);
      if(rescueSaved>=5){ victory(); return; }
    }
  }
  for(var q=0;q<rescueFires.length;q++){
    var fp2=rescueFires[q];
    fp2.r=Math.min(5.5, fp2.r+dt*0.045);
    fp2.mesh.scale.setScalar(fp2.r/2.2);
    if(Math.random()<dt*6) spawnBurst(new THREE.Vector3(fp2.x+(Math.random()-0.5)*fp2.r, 0.6, fp2.z+(Math.random()-0.5)*fp2.r), 0xff6a1e, 2, 2);
    for(var h=0;h<units.length;h++){
      var u=units[h];
      if(u.side!=='hero'||u.dead) continue;
      var hx=u.group.position.x-fp2.x, hz=u.group.position.z-fp2.z;
      if(hx*hx+hz*hz < fp2.r*fp2.r){
        u.hp-=10*dt; u.hpbar.set(Math.max(0,u.hp/u.maxHp));
        u.group.userData.flash=0.6;
        if(u.hp<=0 && !u.dead){
          u.dead=true; u.state='dying'; u.deathT=0;
          fbExtinguishPoof(u.group);
          spawnBurst(u.group.position.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0)), 0xff8c2e, 16, 6);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  if(heroesAlive()===0){ defeat(); return; }
  var dist=21*camDistMul, hh=13.5*camDistMul;
  camera.position.set(arenaCenter.x, hh, arenaCenter.z+dist);
  camera.lookAt(arenaCenter.x, 1, arenaCenter.z-2);
}

var fpsAcc=0, fpsN=0, fpsT=0, titleA=0;
var __fbLastPX = null, __fbLastPZ = null, __fbTimeAcc = 0;
function animate(){
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  var dt=Math.min(clock.getDelta(), 0.05), t=clock.elapsedTime;

  // Task tracking: distance + time
  try {
    if (typeof fbTaskEvent === 'function' && typeof player !== 'undefined' && player && player.group && mpInGame) {
      var px = player.group.position.x, pz = player.group.position.z;
      if (__fbLastPX !== null) {
        var dx = px - __fbLastPX, dz = pz - __fbLastPZ;
        var dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dz*dz);
        if (dist > 0.01) fbTaskEvent('distance', dist);
      }
      __fbLastPX = px; __fbLastPZ = pz;
      __fbTimeAcc += dt;
      if (__fbTimeAcc >= 60) { fbTaskEvent('time_min', 1); if (typeof __fbSeasonXP === 'function') __fbSeasonXP(10, 'time'); __fbTimeAcc = 0; }
    }
  } catch(e){}

  for(var i=0;i<torches.length;i++){
    var tc=torches[i], s=0.85+0.3*Math.sin(t*10+tc.phase);
    tc.fl.scale.set(1.5*s,2.2*(0.9+0.25*Math.sin(t*13+tc.phase)),1);
    tc.gl.material.opacity=0.55+0.2*Math.sin(t*7+tc.phase);
  }
  if(window.__voltOrbs) for(var v2=0;v2<window.__voltOrbs.length;v2++){
    var vo=window.__voltOrbs[v2];
    if(vo.arc){
      vo.m.material.opacity=0.3+0.6*Math.abs(Math.sin(t*7+vo.ph));
      if(Math.random()<dt*6){
        var pts=vo.m.geometry.attributes.position;
        for(var p3=1;p3<6;p3++){ pts.setX(p3, vo.bx+(Math.random()-0.5)*1.4); pts.setZ(p3, vo.bz+(Math.random()-0.5)*1.4); }
        pts.needsUpdate=true;
      }
    } else vo.m.scale.setScalar(1+0.15*Math.sin(t*4+vo.ph));
  }
  if(window.__banners) for(var b2=0;b2<window.__banners.length;b2++){
    window.__banners[b2].m.rotation.y=Math.sin(t*1.2+window.__banners[b2].ph)*0.18;
  }
  if(window.__smog) for(var s4=0;s4<window.__smog.length;s4++){
    var sm2=window.__smog[s4];
    sm2.s.position.x+=sm2.vx*dt;
    if(sm2.s.position.x>22) sm2.s.position.x=-22;
  }
  if(window.__lava) window.__lava.material.color.setHSL(0.045+0.012*Math.sin(t*2.2), 1, 0.5+0.06*Math.sin(t*3.1));
  if(window.__river) window.__river.material.color.setHSL(0.06+0.01*Math.sin(t*2.6), 1, 0.5);

  if(cine){
    updateCine(t, dt);
  } else if(window.__fbPausedShared === true && (function(){ var pm = document.getElementById('pausemenu'); return pm && pm.style.display === 'flex'; })()){
    /* PAUSED (gamer-check fix 2026-10-12): freeze every gameplay state.
       Before this, the pause flag only opened the menu — the single-player
       world kept running behind it. Ambience above still animates. */
  } else if(state==='TITLE'){
    titleA+=dt*0.18;
    camera.position.set(Math.sin(titleA)*16, 8, 40+Math.cos(titleA)*16);
    camera.lookAt(0,1.5,40);
    for(var k=0;k<titleCast.length;k++) updateBaby(titleCast[k], t, dt);
  } else if(state==='EXPLORE'){
    updateExplore(dt, t);
  } else if(state==='BATTLE'){
    if(battleKind==='rescue') updateRescue(dt, t); else updateBattle(dt, t);
  } else if(state==='VICTORY'||state==='DEFEAT'){
    for(var u2=0;u2<units.length;u2++) if(!units[u2].dead) updateBaby(units[u2].group, t, dt);
  }

  updateParticles(dt);
  updateDmg(dt);
  // sun shadow rig follows the player so shadows stay crisp everywhere
  if(window.__sun){
    var sp=(typeof player!=='undefined'&&player&&player.group)?player.group.position:null;
    var sx=sp?sp.x:0, sz=sp?sp.z:40;
    window.__sun.position.set(sx-14,26,sz+12);
    window.__sun.target.position.set(sx,0,sz);
    window.__sun.target.updateMatrixWorld();
  }
  if(typeof FBF!=='undefined') FBF.update(dt);
  updateEmbers(dt);
  renderer.render(scene, camera);

  fpsAcc+=dt; fpsN++; fpsT+=dt;
  if(fpsT>0.5){
    var _fps = Math.round(fpsN/fpsAcc);
    document.getElementById('fps').textContent=_fps;
    // auto quality: if FPS stays low, drop to low quality for smoothness
    try{
      if(typeof FBQ!=='undefined' && FBQ.level!=='low'){
        window._fbLowFpsN = (_fps < 25) ? (window._fbLowFpsN||0)+1 : 0;
        if(window._fbLowFpsN >= 6){
          window._fbLowFpsN = 0;
          FBQ.level='low'; FBQ.pixelRatio=1; FBQ.shadows=false;
          try{ renderer.setPixelRatio(1); }catch(e){}
          try{ renderer.shadowMap.enabled=false; }catch(e){}
          try{ localStorage.setItem('fb_quality','low'); }catch(e){}
        }
      }
    }catch(e){}
    fpsAcc=0;fpsN=0;fpsT=0;
  }
}

/* Fire Babys multiplayer client — fire-babys-net.js
 *
 * Classic script (no modules, no dependencies). Exposes window.FireBabysNet.
 *
 *   const net = new FireBabysNet({ server: "wss://<your-worker>.workers.dev" });
 *   const { code } = await net.createLobby({ mode: "4v4" });
 *   await net.connect(code, { name: "Jeff" });
 *   net.on("lobby", (state) => renderPlayerList(state));
 *   net.on("pos", (p) => moveRemoteDot(p.id, p.x, p.y));
 *   net.setReady(true);
 *   // host: net.start();
 *   net.sendMove({ x: 100, y: 200, dir: 90 });   // throttled to 12Hz internally
 *   net.sendAction({ kind: "extinguish", x, y });

  var MAX_PLAYERS = 30;
  var MODES = { "2v2": 4, "4v4": 8, "6v6": 12, "7v7": 14, "15v15": 30 };
  var MOVE_HZ = 12;
  var PING_INTERVAL_MS = 20000;
  var RECONNECT_DELAYS = [1000, 2000, 5000, 10000]; // backoff steps

  function isValidMode(m) {
    return m === "coop" || Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(MODES, m);
  }

  function FireBabysNet(opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    this.server = (opts.server || "").replace(/\/$/, "");
    this.moveHz = opts.moveHz || MOVE_HZ;
    this.handlers = {};
    this.ws = null;
    this.code = null;
    this.playerId = null;
    this.token = null;
    this.isHost = false;
    this.state = null; // last lobby snapshot
    this.connected = false;
    this.reconnectAttempt = 0;
    this.reconnectTimer = null;
    this.shouldReconnect = false;
    this.lastMoveSent = 0;
    this.lastPing = 0;
    this.latencyMs = null;
    this._name = "";
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ events
  FireBabysNet.prototype.on = function (evt, fn) {
    (this.handlers[evt] = this.handlers[evt] || []).push(fn);
    return this;
  };
  FireBabysNet.prototype.off = function (evt, fn) {
    var h = this.handlers[evt];
    if (!h) return this;
    this.handlers[evt] = h.filter(function (f) { return f !== fn; });
    return this;
  };
  FireBabysNet.prototype.emit = function (evt, data) {
    var h = this.handlers[evt] || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < h.length; i++) {
      try { h[i](data); } catch (e) { /* never let a handler kill the socket */ }
    }

    return this.server.replace(/^wss:/, "https:").replace(/^ws:/, "http:");
  };

  FireBabysNet.prototype.createLobby = function (opts) {
    var self = this;
    opts = opts || {};
    var mode = isValidMode(opts.mode) ? opts.mode : "coop";
    return fetch(this.httpBase() + "/api/lobby", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ mode: mode }),
    })
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (j) {
        if (!j.ok) throw new Error(j.error || "create failed");
        return j.code;
      });
  };

  FireBabysNet.listLobbies = function (server) {
    var base = String(server || "").replace(/\/$/, "")
      .replace(/^wss:/, "https:").replace(/^ws:/, "http:");

      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (j) { return j.ok ? j.lobbies : []; });

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ websocket
  FireBabysNet.prototype.connect = function (code, opts) {

    this.reconnectAttempt = 0;

  FireBabysNet.prototype._open = function (name, token) {
    var self = this;
    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
      var url = self.server + "/lobby/" + encodeURIComponent(self.code) +

      ws.onerror = function () {
        if (!settled) { settled = true; clearTimeout(timeout); reject(new Error("websocket error")); }
      };

  FireBabysNet.prototype._onMessage = function (data, resolve, reject, settle) {
    var msg;

    if (!msg || typeof msg.t !== "string") return;

    // First message must be welcome (resolves connect()).
    if (msg.t === "welcome") {
      this.playerId = msg.playerId;
      this.token = msg.token;
      this.isHost = !!msg.isHost;
      this.state = msg.state || null;
      this.connected = true;
      this.reconnectAttempt = 0;
      this._startPing();
      try { localStorage.setItem("fbmp:" + this.code, this.token); } catch (e) {}
      settle();
      resolve({ playerId: this.playerId, isHost: this.isHost, reconnected: !!msg.reconnected });
      this.emit("welcome", msg);
      if (msg.state) this.emit("lobby", msg.state);

    }
    if (msg.t === "error") { this.emit("error", msg.msg || "error"); return; }

    switch (msg.t) {
      case "lobby":
        this.state = msg.state || this.state;
        this.emit("lobby", msg.state);
        break;
      case "joined": case "rejoined": case "left":
        this.emit("presence", msg);
        break;
      case "host":
        if (this.state) this.state.hostId = msg.hostId;
        this.isHost = (msg.hostId === this.playerId);
        this.emit("host", msg);
        break;
      case "pos": this.emit("pos", msg); break;
      case "action": this.emit("action", msg); break;
      case "start":
        this.state = msg.state || this.state;
        this.emit("start", msg);
        break;
      case "end": this.emit("end", msg); break;
      case "pong":
        if (msg.ts) this.latencyMs = Date.now() - msg.ts;
        this.emit("pong", { latencyMs: this.latencyMs });

  FireBabysNet.prototype._startPing = function () {
    var self = this;

      self._send({ t: "ping", ts: Date.now() });

  FireBabysNet.prototype._stopPing = function () {
    if (this._pingTimer) clearInterval(this._pingTimer);

  };

  FireBabysNet.prototype._onClose = function () {

    var self = this;

      var token = self.token;

  };

  FireBabysNet.prototype.disconnect = function () {
    this.shouldReconnect = false;
    if (this.reconnectTimer) clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimer);
    this._stopPing();

  FireBabysNet.prototype.setReady = function (ready) {

  FireBabysNet.prototype.setMode = function (mode) {

  };

  FireBabysNet.prototype.end = function (results) {
    return this._send({ t: "end", results: results || null });
  };

  /** Throttled movement send. Call every frame; library caps to moveHz. */
  FireBabysNet.prototype.sendMove = function (move) {

    return this._send({
      t: "move",
      x: +move.x || 0, y: +move.y || 0,
      dir: +move.dir || 0,
      anim: String(move.anim || "").slice(0, 16),

      x: +action.x || 0, y: +action.y || 0,

  FireBabysNet.MODES = MODES;
